query_normalized: leveraging llms to generate unit tests from api documentation computer science
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (a) and (b) as it directly measures the same mechanism (using LLMs to generate test inputs) and domain (RESTful API testing) specified in the user's question, even though it focuses on payload synthesis rather than the specific input of "documentation." It provides the canonical prior work for the sub-problem of LLM-driven API test generation, which is essential for a literature review on the broader topic.
